eligibility.value: Any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker.
eligibility.quote: This Instant e-PAN service can be used by any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker.

fees.value: The service is free of cost.
fees.quote: No. The service is free of cost.

issuing_authority.quote: You may select the any one of the documents(s) to be shared with the Income Tax Department as proof of date of birth.

steps.value: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click 'Instant e-PAN' under Quick Links, then click 'Get New e-PAN' on the e-PAN page.
steps.quote: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click ‘Instant e-PAN’ under Quick Links, then click ‘Get New e-PAN’ on the e-PAN page.

registration_steps.value: Click Register on the e-Filing portal.

common_problems.problem: DigiLocker platform is down or not loading

fix.value: Wait for few minutes and retry, as this is often a temporary service outage.
fix.quote: If the DigiLocker platform is down or not loading Wait for few minutes and retry, as this is often a temporary service outage.

common_problems.problem: Newly created DigiLocker account does not show documents yet

fix.value: Wait for few minutes and refresh the 'Issued Documents' section before retrying the Instant e-PAN request.
fix.quote: Wait for few minutes and refresh the ‘Issued Documents’ section before retrying the Instant e-PAN request.
